LanguageData.CQF_SymmetryDescription: Mirror CQF map editing across the selected axes. Placement, deletion, terrain, roofs, property brushes, movement and rotation are synchronized. Object configurations are synchronized when their editor closes.
LanguageData.CQF_SymmetryFailed: Symmetry operation could not be completed: {0}
LanguageData.CQF_SymmetryNoTarget: No corresponding object exists at the mirrored position.
LanguageData.CQF_SymmetryAmbiguous: More than one corresponding object exists at the mirrored position.
LanguageData.CQF_SymmetryOverlap: Mirrored objects would overlap. Adjust the symmetry axis or placement.
LanguageData.CQF_SymmetryAxisMove: An object on the symmetry axis cannot be moved away from it while symmetry is enabled.
LanguageData.CQF_SymmetryConfigurationFailed: The object configuration could not be synchronized. See the error log for details.
LanguageData.CQF_SymmetryDragTip: Drag an arrow handle to move its axis. With no editing tool selected, you can also drag the line or the intersection. Positions snap to cell centers or edges. Right-click or press Esc to cancel a drag.
